column2: Assessment of Sleep Dynamics in a Simulated Space Station Environment

column1: An electronic sleep/wake questionnaire was completed upon awakening and before bedtime using the Ames Interactive Reporting Log (AIRLOG).  AIRLOG is a tool developed exclusively for research in aviation and ground transportation environments; the instrument was developed by NASA Ames Research Center and includes separate components that relate to the events of the day preceding the sleep period, the quality of sleep period, and the ensuing wake time.
